title: Nice bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; gallon is oversized
text:
Nice bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung; gallon is oversized. This is a decent plastic bag organizer that comes in four separate compartments with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. Also, there are no felt feet for when it is placed on the counter or in a drawer. However, the beauty of this design is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

I love the way this keeps all my plastic bags in order. However, there are two other negatives besides the fact that it cannot be hung. The writing on the sandwich compartment is not as clear as the others. Also, the gallon holder is oversized compared to other organizers I tried.

Overall, this is a decent organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I do wish it had feet and that it had a frame for at least three or all the compartments so that it could be hung. I also wish the gallon holder was not so oversized (on the wide side) and that the label on the sandwich bag holder was clearer.

The current price of $26.99 is on the low side competitively priced for this. Note that it also ships with a slotted spoon. However, I personally feel this [[ASIN:B09D5Y63D1 one]] is better if one is looking for four separate compartments. For a variety of organizers (separate and one unit), then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. I tried all of these and the style is based on what one desires.
